allowed_edit_paths_and_prohibited_tests_.action_suggested: Continue treating policy violations as hard gates.
allowed_edit_paths_and_prohibited_tests_.what_happened: Allowed code paths and test paths were recorded, tests were non-editable, policy violations were zero, and raw oracle exposure was false.
allowed_edit_paths_and_prohibited_tests_.why_it_matters: Adapter pass-rate differences are not explained by committed evidence of path-policy or oracle leakage.

base_commit_and_workspace_construction.action_suggested: No paid rerun is suggested by workspace construction evidence.
base_commit_and_workspace_construction.what_happened: Ready-package rows record resolvable base commits and source repos for the supplement missing-cell package.
base_commit_and_workspace_construction.why_it_matters: Both adapters should have worked from comparable clean task workspaces.

model_identifier_or_family.action_suggested: Report the difference as a same-model cross-harness ACUT configuration difference.
model_identifier_or_family.what_happened: Adapter config and score tables record gpt-5.4-mini for both ACUT configurations.
model_identifier_or_family.why_it_matters: The observed gap should not be reported as a model-only result, but the model identifier is aligned across adapters.

pricing_and_accounting.action_suggested: Keep cost claims token-estimated unless provider billing becomes available.
pricing_and_accounting.what_happened: Cost reconciliation is complete with usage observed for all new cells; exact provider billing is explicitly unavailable.
pricing_and_accounting.why_it_matters: Cost/latency interpretation can use token-estimated accounting but must not claim exact provider spend.

required_endpoint_variables.action_suggested: Keep this endpoint rule for paid work.
required_endpoint_variables.what_happened: Both adapters require LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_API_KEY, all supplement batch summaries record endpoint variables present, and the final decision records endpoint compliance pass.
required_endpoint_variables.why_it_matters: The adapter comparison is not explained by one harness using a different auth path in the committed evidence.

score_table_import_rules.action_suggested: Keep the invalid cell non-scoreable in analysis.
score_table_import_rules.what_happened: The combined manifest covers all 120 selected cells, preserves the one non-scoreable cell, and the completed paid decision was not changed.
score_table_import_rules.why_it_matters: Denominators are explicit and the invalid output was not silently converted into a pass or fail.

solver_visible_task_statement_source.action_suggested: Use sanitized statement digests when auditing future packages.
solver_visible_task_statement_source.what_happened: Ready-package integrity records solver-visible statements, statement digests, no raw diff marker, and no target commit exposure for the new supplement package.
solver_visible_task_statement_source.why_it_matters: The paid supplement was driven by task statements rather than hidden oracle material.

timeout_concurrency_retry_policy.action_suggested: Report adapter results separately and avoid model-only superiority claims.
timeout_concurrency_retry_policy.what_happened: Both adapters use the same recorded timeout and paid concurrency is one; Kilo uses strict-final completion mode as a documented harness setting.
timeout_concurrency_retry_policy.why_it_matters: Harness/tooling differences are part of the ACUT configuration unless they break benchmark rules.

usage_and_cost_record_completeness.action_suggested: Do not claim exact billed dollars.
usage_and_cost_record_completeness.what_happened: Cost reconciliation and adapter metrics mark cost/latency accounting complete for the supplement.
usage_and_cost_record_completeness.why_it_matters: Cost and latency comparisons are usable as token-estimated diagnostics.

verifier_replay_policy.what_happened: System design and supplement runbook require diff replay in fresh verifier workspaces, and ready-package rows record verifier commands.
verifier_replay_policy.why_it_matters: The score table is benchmark-side verification evidence, not self-reported ACUT success.

limitations.effect: Exact invalid-output text cannot be reconstructed; committed sanitized score tables are sufficient for scoreability and fairness denominators.
limitations.limitation: Raw solver transcripts and raw ACUT logs were intentionally not read.
